_about: Bin colours councils publish but don't put in their collection data, keyed by GSS code. Used only when the council's own bin name has no colour; a resident's choice always wins. One entry per council: category -> colour (blue, black, green, brown, grey, purple, red, yellow), plus where it came from.

E09000013.note: Wheeled bins: green recycling bin (blue lid), black general waste bin. Some homes use clear recycling sacks instead.
